purpose: Synthetic event and bounded-memory diagnostic for S-QSTN RulePack v2.0.
fixture_policy: No human labels, model outputs, or inferred violation events may enter the memory ledger.
guardrails: The memory horizon is a synthetic fixture parameter, not a human forgetting estimate.
Only verified events may update categorical state.
Ordinary respondent denial is not an agent violation.
Expired memory-view events remain available only in the audit ledger.
The diagnostic does not calibrate answer probabilities or establish human-likeness.
